Painted still on a fortress wall-walk at midnight, close on the top of a rough granite parapet, the river far below as soft silver bokeh under a full moon. A half-eaten ripe peach sits on the stone where it has just been set down, its bitten side turned up, flesh wet and gleaming, the stone at its heart just showing. Golden juice has pooled under it and runs over the edge of the parapet in one slow thick glistening line down the face of the warm stone, catching the moonlight the whole way down. A dropped shawl lies in a soft heap at the foot of the parapet. ONE device: the single line of juice running down the stone. Moon-silver, sage-green #8AAFA0 in the shadows, ice-blue #7EB8F0 rim on the wet. PAINTED STILL — no people, no figures, no faces, no hands anywhere in the frame; the place or object IS the subject. Openly erotic metaphor: the shapes, wetness, swelling, thrusting and release unmistakably read as bodies and sex, the way a frank erotic painting does — yet everything stays landscape and object, no nudity, no literal anatomy. A 2:1 movie frame composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop (nothing important at the top or bottom edge). Hand-painted WATERCOLOR-AND-OIL: granulated wet-in-wet washes and broken-colour dabs for sky, water and stone, dry-brush texture, soft bleeding edges and a faint paper grain; oil glazes deepen the darks and a touch of impasto lands on the single brightest highlight. Romantic-painting layout: one bold shape, at least half the frame quiet negative space, distant detail dissolving into haze. Film tenebrism: one hard directional key (sun, moon or lamp) against big dark masses, a thin edge of real light along the subject, painted bokeh from small real lights. Beautiful, luminous, painterly. NOT photoreal, NOT 3D, NOT a cartoon. No text. No watermark. NIGHT GROUND: the frame is built on BLACK — crushed ink-black night masses around the subject, the place pulled out of the dark only where the one key light (fire, lamp, torch, moon) falls, small warm bokeh in the black; the figure is the bright thing in a dark frame.
